results.name: ui/initialize returns hostCapabilities
ui/initialize result carries hostContext
results.caveat: SHOULD, not MUST — a host may legitimately omit hostContext, which would FAIL here. We assert presence; a richer version would only validate shape when present.

tool.name: run_conformance
tool.description: Run the MCP Apps conformance test suite against this host.

results.name: host provides theme CSS variables (styles.variables)
results.caveat: Optional (MAY). Signal only — inspect the exact values in the Inspector panel.

results.name: theme-aware values use CSS light-dark()
results.caveat: SHOULD, and only observable when the host passes style variables. Non-color variables (radii, shadows) legitimately don't use light-dark(), so this is a signal, not a hard fail.

results.name: host provides custom fonts (styles.css.fonts)
results.caveat: Optional (MAY). Signal only — inspect the font CSS in the Inspector panel.

results.name: host proxies tools/call to the server
results.caveat: The server also sees this call directly, so it can be corroborated server-side.

results.name: host rejects app call to a model-only tool
results.caveat: Covers the app→tool direction only. The complementary `visibility/app-tool-hidden` (tool absent from the *agent's* list) needs the agent vantage and isn't measurable here.
results.message: host must reject an app's tools/call for a tool lacking "app" visibility

results.name: ui/request-display-mode returns the resulting mode
results.caveat: Requests the current mode ('inline') to avoid a disruptive change, but a host may still re-render as a side effect.

results.name: host and sandbox have different origins
results.caveat: Host ≠ Sandbox. The View runs same-origin inside the Sandbox, so this checks window.top (the host), not window.parent (the sandbox). Opened top-level (no host), window.top === self and this FAILs — correct, it's not in a host.

results.name: sandbox grants allow-scripts + allow-same-origin
results.caveat: Inferred: scripts executing ⇒ allow-scripts; non-opaque window.origin ⇒ allow-same-origin.

results.name: host sends tool-input after initialize
results.caveat: Captured via the ontoolinput callback (registered before connect). TIMEOUT means the host never sent it for the launching tool.

results.name: host sends tool-result on completion
results.caveat: Captured via ontoolresult. Some hosts may not replay tool-result for the tool that launched the view — TIMEOUT flags that.

results.name: host stops tool-input-partial once tool-input is sent
results.caveat: Only catches a violation if the host actually streams partials; our launcher tool has no streamable args, so this usually passes vacuously (0 partials observed).

results.name: host does not switch to an undeclared display mode
results.caveat: We declare only inline/fullscreen in appCapabilities, then request the undeclared 'pip'.

results.name: unavailable mode request returns the current mode
results.caveat: SHOULD — assumes the current mode is stable between reading hostContext and the request.

results.name: declared connectDomains origin is allowed
results.caveat: The runner declares connectDomains: ["https://modelcontextprotocol.io/"]. ⚠️ a network failure also reads as "not allowed", so the origin must be reachable.

results.name: undeclared origin stays blocked when a CSP is declared
results.caveat: Backed by csp-allow-declared as the positive control: the declared origin works, so blocking this one is genuinely the CSP, not a blanket fetch failure.
results.message: the host must not allow the undeclared origin https://example.com/ (no loosening beyond declared domains)

results.name: host constructs the CSP from the declared domains
results.caveat: Reads the applied CSP via a <meta> tag or the securitypolicyviolation event's originalPolicy. ⚠️ if the host delivers CSP only by HTTP header and no violation fires (or originalPolicy is redacted), it can't be read.
results.message: could not read the applied CSP (no <meta> tag and no securitypolicyviolation fired)

results.name: host resizes the iframe on size-changed (flexible mode)
results.caveat: Flexible mode only (returns vacuously if the host pins a fixed height). Relies on autoResize reporting the taller content and the view's window.innerHeight reflecting the resize; the host may clamp to maxHeight.

results.name: host forwards resources/list from the view to the server
results.caveat: Exercises resources/list passthrough (distinct from tools/proxy-call's tools/call). Gated on the host advertising serverResources.
results.message: host does not advertise serverResources — resource passthrough not supported

results.name: host declares content-block modalities for message / update-model-context
results.caveat: Draft (specification/draft). Signal only — reports the SupportedContentBlockModalities the host advertises.
results.message: host declares no content-block modalities (message: not declared · updateModelContext: not declared)

results.name: the View is wrapped in an intermediate sandbox proxy
results.caveat: Paired with sandbox-distinct-origin (Host != Sandbox): window.parent (the sandbox) != window.top (the host) proves an intermediate proxy frame. Opened top-level, window.top === self and this FAILs — correct, it's not in a host.

results.name: host notifies the view when the theme changes
results.caveat: The Runner toggles the host theme and the view resolves on the hostcontextchanged notification. SKIP if the host doesn't emit it (e.g. theme pinned, not following the OS).

results.name: ui/open-link opens the URL
results.caveat: Host-vantage: the sandboxed view can't see the host open a tab, so the Runner triggers ui/open-link and verifies a tab opened (accepting a consent dialog if shown; some hosts open with none).
results.message: host did not open the link

results.name: ui/message is added to the conversation
results.caveat: Host-vantage: the view can't read the host's conversation, so the Runner confirms the marker appeared (some hosts draft into the composer — commitDraftedMessage sends it).

results.name: host hides app-only tools from the agent
results.caveat: `conformance_probe` is app-only (visibility ["app"]) so it must not be in the model-facing tools/list. Uses the desktop-host tool-list affordance if available, else the agent's own (truthful) enumeration.

results.name: ui/update-model-context reaches the model next turn
results.caveat: Multi-turn, host-vantage: seeds ui/update-model-context then asks the agent to recall it; confirms the host fed the context to the model on the following turn.

results.name: sampling/createMessage returns a completion
results.caveat: Draft. Capability-gated. The host has full discretion (model selection, rate limiting, user approval); the Runner triggers the call, may approve it, and confirms the reply.
results.message: host does not advertise the sampling capability

results.name: ui/download-file downloads a file
results.caveat: Draft. Host-vantage: the download and its confirmation dialog occur outside the sandboxed iframe, so the Runner confirms.
results.message: host does not advertise the downloadFile capability

results.name: host calls an app-registered tool
results.caveat: Draft (App-Provided Tools). Requires the host to expose app-registered tools to the agent; the Runner asks the agent to call it and the harness detects the callback.
results.message: the agent did not call the app-registered tool conformance_ping

results.name: host renders the View in a sandboxed iframe
results.caveat: Operator-read: the sandboxed View's content is cross-origin, but the <iframe> element (and its sandbox attribute) lives in the host document and is readable. Asserts the host uses at least one sandboxed iframe.

results.name: only the last of several model-context updates reaches the model
results.caveat: Sends two updates before the next user message; the reply should carry the fresh code, not the stale one. Weak if the agent doesn't echo the code verbatim.

results.name: host logs the CSP configuration for security review
results.caveat: Operator-observable only: scans the browser console for a logged CSP; a host that logs server-side (not the console) reads as a fail here.
results.message: no CSP configuration found in the host console (SHOULD log for security review)
